CHECK ((((started_at IS NULL) OR (started_at >= created_at)) AND ((completed_at IS NULL) OR (completed_at >= started_at)) AND ((cancelled_at IS NULL) OR (cancelled_at >= created_at))))
CHECK ((((started_at IS NULL) OR (updated_at >= started_at)) AND ((completed_at IS NULL) OR (updated_at >= completed_at)) AND ((cancelled_at IS NULL) OR (updated_at >= cancelled_at))))

CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM manufacturer)) > 0) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM model)) > 0)))
CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM registration_number)) > 0) AND ((registration_number)::text = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM registration_number)))))
FOREIGN KEY (maintenance_id, vehicle_id, school_id) REFERENCES maintenance(maintenance_id, vehicle_id, school_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id, school_id) REFERENCES vehicle(vehicle_id, school_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE

CHECK ((((maintenance_id IS NULL) AND (expected_maintenance_revision IS NULL) AND (resulting_maintenance_revision IS NULL)) OR ((maintenance_id IS NOT NULL) AND (resulting_maintenance_revision IS NOT NULL) AND ((expected_maintenance_revision IS NULL) OR (expected_maintenance_revision > 0)))))

CHECK ((((expected_vehicle_revision IS NULL) OR (resulting_vehicle_revision >= expected_vehicle_revision)) AND ((expected_maintenance_revision IS NULL) OR (resulting_maintenance_revision > expected_maintenance_revision))))

CHECK ((((expected_vehicle_revision IS NULL) OR (expected_vehicle_revision > 0)) AND (resulting_vehicle_revision > 0) AND ((resulting_maintenance_revision IS NULL) OR (resulting_maintenance_revision > 0))))

CHECK (((resume_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Pending'::character varying, 'Blocking'::character varying, 'SchedulingBlocked'::character varying, 'ApplyingVehicleState'::character varying, 'ReleasingBlock'::character varying, 'Completed'::character varying, 'Rejected'::character varying, 'NeedsRecovery'::character varying])::text[])))
